prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: ONE transparent 2D animation sprite sheet with FOUR COMPLETE CHARACTER drawings in a precisely spaced 2 by 2 grid, read top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. Square canvas. Four equal square cells, invisible borders, each character fully inside its own cell with 8% empty margins. No labels, panels, text captions, floor, shadows, background, motion streaks or duplicated body parts. Truly transparent alpha.
Image 1 is the identity/style reference: chibi blue gradient wavy hair, ahoge, blue-white whale ears and blue whale tail, orange asterisk hair clip, cream hoodie with caramel bow and orange sleeve asterisks, small flower patch on pocket, tan pleated skirt and white frill, white flower legwarmers, brown Mary Jane shoes. Preserve identity, head/body ratio, rendering style and camera across ALL FOUR drawings. Badge says exactly "Claude" in black on white, orange rim; do not replace it with a flower. Each pose is a complete organically drawn body, two arms/hands and two legs only. No paper cutout articulation. Character's scale and horizontal center identical in every cell. Action: 吃白饭. Image 2 supplies the seated rice-bowl pose, only as supporting pose reference. All four frames sit cross-legged, same character/head scale. LEFT hand holds a single white bowl of rice steadily at belly height. RIGHT hand uses one small wooden spoon. Exactly two hands. Frame 1: spoon scoops rice from bowl, mouth closed looking at food. Frame 2: loaded spoon lifts halfway to mouth, elbow naturally bends, bowl steady. Frame 3: spoon reaches open mouth, eating a bite, cheerful hungry face, spoon held visibly by right fingers. Frame 4: mouth closes to chew, cheeks gently full, spoon lowers toward bowl, satisfied smile. No floating utensils, spoon clipping through face, duplicate hands, giant spilling rice or changing bowl size. Whole body and props drawn together in each frame.
